meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 它会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装,拉取最新源码做对比,输出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上对应的命令输出或文件依据。整个过程只诊断,不改动你的安装、配置和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词,或在安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex 健康检查
say.note: 会输出环境、各项检查结论与修复建议

say.text: 我刚更新了 Codex,行为有点怪,做个 doctor
say.note: 会抓取命令输出并给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL

say.text: 检查我的安装和最新源码有没有偏差
say.note: 会对比本地文件与已同步的最新源码

howto.what_en: Claude checks your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report, each verdict citing its command output or file. It only diagnoses; it never changes your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or omo-codex, or when Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex health check for me
say_en.note: Prints environment, check verdicts and fixes

say_en.text: I just updated Codex and it acts odd, run doctor
say_en.note: Captures command output and gives PASS/WARN/FAIL

say_en.text: Check my install for drift against latest sources
say_en.note: Diffs local files versus synced sources
